did: Built home's half of the interview week. Home keeps each week the Monday routine puts in the mailbox and serves it to the phone. It keeps the phone's sends as a draft until the deadline and the one standing then as final, and serves each question's and card's take or silence. Once the week closes, it puts the final record in the mailbox for the essay routine. The draft and final rules Rust Rounds already had are now shared by both kinds of week instead of copied. Two independent reviews ran; their findings were fixed, one of them a bug my own first fix introduced.

calls.title: Where the interview week's sends are kept
options: Their own two tables, with Rust Rounds' draft and final logic shared in code
One shared pair of tables with a kind column, renaming Rust Rounds' tables
Copy Rust Rounds' code for the interview
calls.why: Renaming Rust Rounds' tables would have moved their ledger stores and its essay checks in the middle of the run. Copying would have meant two sets of the same rules to keep in step. Sharing the logic keeps the rules in one place, and only the table name differs.
calls.undo: A later migration can fold both pairs into one table with a kind column; rust_round_repo::draft already takes the kind.

calls.title: The interview week has no table of its own
options: Keep it as the mailbox file it arrives as, as Rust Rounds' week is
Copy it into its own table
calls.why: Nothing is queued for an interview week, so the brief file home already keeps holds everything it needs; a table would be a second copy.
calls.undo: Add a table and fill it from mailbox_item if the week ever needs more than its file.

left: My data's kept count does not include interview finals yet (paulgsc/server#844). It needs a new kind on both sides and is not on Monday's path.
